_doc: Pre-fight banter shown before round 1. 'pairs' keys are the two fighter ids sorted alphabetically and joined with '|'. Otherwise each fighter says one random 'generic' line.

flash: Let's make this quick. Well... quick for me.
I'll be done before you blink.
I really don't want to do this. But I will.
green_arrow: You're not walking away from this.
I've trained on an island for five years. Bring it.
supergirl: I'm going to hold back. A little.
Hope is stronger than you think.
black_canary: I've heard enough out of you.
Let's keep this short. I've got a city to run.
vibe: Okay, okay, I'm vibing a very bad future for you.
Breach, punch, quip. That's the plan.
I have a good feeling about this. Mostly.
wild_dog: Nothing personal. Okay, a little personal.
Rules are simple: I hit, you fall.
martian_manhunter: I sense your next move already.
There is no shame in yielding.
I will not let you harm anyone else.
citizen_steel: Historian by day, wall of steel by night.
This is going in the history books.
deathstroke: You were never a challenge. Only a contract.
One eye is all I need.
reverse_flash: I'm always one step ahead of you.
Time is on my side. It always was.
Let me show you what speed really is.
reign: Your world will burn with you.
vandal_savage: I have outlived empires. I will outlive you.
Fifty thousand years of experience. And you?
Kneel, and I may let you live a century.
vigilante: Judge, jury, and very short trial.
No masks can hide what you did.
The law let you go. I won't.
control_freak: Places, everyone! This is the season finale!
Ratings are about to go through the roof!

flash|reverse_flash: Hello, Flash. Did you miss me?
flash|green_arrow: Barry. Don't make me use the boxing glove arrow.
You'd have to catch me first.
black_canary|green_arrow: You taught me how to fight, Ollie. Bad idea.
reign|supergirl: Then you've never seen what hope can do.
citizen_steel|vandal_savage: I've met better soldiers than you, boy.
Yeah? I've read about every one of them.
vandal_savage|vibe: Vandal Savage. Okay. Cool cool cool. Not cool.
vigilante|wild_dog: You're one bad day from being me, Rene.
Nah. I'm the guy who stops you.
martian_manhunter|reign: Your mind is a storm, Reign.
black_canary|vigilante: Star City has laws. Even for you.
control_freak|flash: Okay, this guy's actually kind of a fan.
deathstroke|wild_dog: Deathstroke? Okay, nobody told me about this.
reverse_flash|vibe: I vibed you. I always vibe you. Every. Single. Time.
Then you know how this ends, Cisco.
